summary: Iteration 19: Verified the full ADMIN feature set (Hutch's Inner Circle) on both backend (pytest, 12/12 passed + 1 skipped) and frontend (Playwright, mobile 390x844). Backend covers admin auth + 403 for non-admin on 9 /api/admin/* endpoints, badge grant/revoke, verify-member, founder grant + /users/{id}/public.is_founder, rank up/down, chat-ban blocks POST /chat/main/messages but /auth/me stays 200, all-ban kills session + POST /auth/login 403 then unban restores login, featured add/get/delete, enhanced-theme on/off, plus bot regression (login/me/leaderboard/founders). Judge comment DELETE test was auto-skipped because no judge submission exists in DB (photo upload gate) — main agent's curl already covered admin/author/non-admin permissions on that endpoint. Frontend: Home shows testID admin-entry + '★ SPOTLIGHT' with Ronin Blade + reason (testID spotlight-<uid>) — tapping opens member profile sheet. Admin Panel (/admin) renders ENHANCED RED THEME switch (admin-red-toggle actually flips whole UI crimson), HOME SPOTLIGHT list with REMOVE, MEMBERS search (admin-search + admin-search-btn), and each admin-member-<id> card with ✓ SKOOL / ★ FOUNDER, derank-/uprank-, mute-/ban- that switch to unban-, tappable badge chips, Reason input + feature-<id>. UP-RANK on Ronin Blade successfully moved BEGINNER LV1 → INTERMEDIATE LV11, MUTE CHAT flipped to the banned pill '⛔ CHAT · till Aug 20…' + UNBAN button as expected. ONE FRONTEND GATING BUG FOUND: the Judge screen's canJudge check does NOT include is_admin, so the test admin (admin@hutchcircle.com, no skool_verified) is blocked at 'THE JUDGE IS LOCKED' and therefore can never reach the del-comment-<id> button, even though the button's own render gate (is_admin || author) is correct. All test data was cleaned up (unbanned members, red theme off, spotlight of member2 removed).

ui_bugs.issue: canJudge = isSubscribed || user?.skool_verified || user?.all_rooms_access || user?.is_founder — admin (is_admin=true, no other flags) is locked out of The Judge and thus can never see the del-comment-<id> delete button. The button itself is correctly gated by (is_admin || author) on line 382-383 but the outer screen never renders for admin. Reference: /app/frontend/app/judge.tsx:110

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/app/judge.tsx line 110: add `|| user?.is_admin` to canJudge so admin can moderate Judge comments in-UI. Backend already treats admin as authorised on the DELETE endpoint.
OPTIONAL cleanup: main agent's test note says to delete admin@hutchcircle.com + member1/member2 seeds and reset featured_members before final launch handoff.
critical_code_review_comments: shared.py is 1701 lines — still well over the 700-line split threshold (flagged in prior iterations). Not blocking this feature.

routes/admin.py get_current_user + _require_admin flow is clean; ban_state correctly parses banned_until, and login/all bans force db.user_sessions.delete_many which is why /auth/me returns 401 (session deleted) rather than 403 (banned) after an all-ban — tests accept both codes.
app/admin.tsx has hardcoded 24h duration for MUTE/BAN buttons — fine for MVP but consider making duration configurable in a follow-up.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12 passed, 1 skipped — Judge delete requires an existing submission, main agent curl-verified)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all admin+spotlight flows working; 1 gating bug found on Judge for admins)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test used existing admin@hutchcircle.com, member1, member2, bot1. All temporary state (bans, featured, up-rank on Ronin) was cleaned up at the end of testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_admin_features.py — reuse as regression. All 12 admin tests are green. Judge delete-comment test auto-skips if no judge_submissions exist; if you need to actually run it, either (a) seed a judge submission via the DB directly, or (b) log in as a skool_verified/email_verified user and hit /api/judge/submit with a small JPEG. Frontend testIDs verified live: admin-entry, spotlight-<uid>, admin-red-toggle, admin-search, admin-search-btn, admin-member-<uid>, derank-<uid>, uprank-<uid>, mute-<uid>, ban-<uid>, unban-<uid>, feature-<uid>. The Judge del-comment-<id> testID exists in the code (judge.tsx:383) and its inner gate is correct — the only blocker is the outer canJudge check missing is_admin (line 110). After main agent fixes that one line, re-run the Judge UI flow.
rca_of_issue: Judge screen access is denied for admin because canJudge omits `user?.is_admin`. The DELETE /api/judge/{sub}/comments/{cid} backend endpoint DOES admit admins (checked in routes/judge.py:171-172), and the JSX renders del-comment-<id> for `(user?.is_admin || c.user_id === user?.user_id)` (judge.tsx:382-383), so a one-token fix on judge.tsx:110 unblocks the whole moderation UI: `const canJudge = isSubscribed || user?.skool_verified || user?.all_rooms_access || user?.is_founder || user?.is_admin;`
